headline: A calm sample briefing for the Morning Bar UI.
tldr: Preview stories are examples for checking layout and interaction.
High priority Arch notices remain pinned above category limits.
The live briefing uses only the approved interests and feed results.

stories.title: Arch Linux manual intervention notice needs a package migration
stories.excerpt: Preview text only. Open the official source to verify current instructions.
stories.summary: A package transition may require a one-time manual command before the next system update.
stories.why_it_matters: Manual Arch actions are always surfaced first so an update cannot quietly leave the system in a partial state.

stories.title: A new paper compares memory-saving attention methods on long contexts
stories.excerpt: Preview text only. This story is not a live research result.
stories.summary: The paper measures cache size and inference quality across several efficient attention techniques.
stories.why_it_matters: Memory use is a key limit when running useful models on a laptop.
